title: Please bring back the side menu/list selector in the Google Tasks iOS app.
body:
Please bring back the side menu/list selector in the Google Tasks iOS app.
I use multiple task lists, and the previous side menu made it very easy to see all my lists at once and quickly switch between them. In the current interface, the lists are displayed as horizontal tabs at the top, which requires repeatedly swiping left and right to find a specific list.
This is much less efficient, especially for users who have many lists. Please restore the option to open a menu showing all task lists vertically, or at least provide an alternative “All Lists” selector.
The previous interface was significantly faster and more practical for managing multiple lists. Thank you.
